versions.content: Error reporting for indirect data provision during trigger transmission Status: DRAFT If development error detection is enabled: TcpIp_TriggerTransmit() shall check if the TcpIp module requested a transmission with indirect data provision for a specific TxPduId. If the check fails, TcpIp_TriggerTransmit() shall refuse the request and raise the development error code TCPIP_E_PDU_DATA_FAILED instead.
